name: Research Agent
description: Identifies improvement opportunities by analyzing agent performance, user feedback, and execution patterns. Proposes research hypotheses and improvement experiments.

inputs.name: targetAgent
inputs.description: Agent ID to analyze (optional - analyzes all if not specified)

inputs.name: analysisScope
inputs.description: Scope of analysis: agent, workflow, workspace, or system

inputs.name: focusArea
inputs.description: Focus area: performance, quality, cost, or all

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: List of identified issues and opportunities

outputs.name: prioritizedActions
outputs.description: Actions prioritized by impact and effort

prompts.hypothesisPrompt:
Based on the findings:
{findings}

Generate research hypotheses that could improve agent performance.

For each hypothesis:
1. Clear statement of what you expect to happen
2. Proposed change or intervention
3. Metrics to measure success
4. Experiment design to validate
5. Confidence level and reasoning
prompts.prioritizationPrompt:
Given these improvement proposals:
{proposals}

Prioritize them considering:
- Expected improvement in fitness score
- Implementation effort (low/medium/high)
- Risk level
- Dependencies on other changes
- Time to realize benefits

Provide a ranked list with justification for the ordering.
